items.title: What Mary Lovelace O'Neal Left Behind
items.summary: "Requiem" is a fitting self-elegy for the painter, precisely because nothing about it feels mournful.

items.title: Latinx Artists Are the New Visionaries
items.summary: Without guarantees of commercial or institutional rewards, their work stems from a shared conviction: We have rich cultures to offer, and we will tell our stories by any means necessary.

items.title: What Does Frida Kahlo Mean Today?
items.summary: A new documentary poses this question across socio-cultural contexts, steering clear of whitewashing the artist’s personal history.

items.title: Martin Puryear’s Liberatory Violence
items.summary: A concern with liberation and revolution runs throughout his exhibition at the High Museum.
